contexts.text: Unless the sense of the letter as it were vanishes...
It then vanishes from his external memory.
When (these things) have become... spontaneous, they vanish from the scientifics. AC 9394:4.
In proportion as instrumental things are made the end, in the same proportion essential things vanish... (thus) truths vanish... good vanishes... celestial things vanish...
This happiness vanishes as soon as they think of recompense.
(This good) vanishes according to the degree of the increase of concupiscence. Signified, Explained.
To melt = to vanish.
It appears as if the literal sense vanishes... through the internal sense; but... it does not vanish...
After scientifics or Knowledges... have performed this use, they as it were vanish from (the external) memory.
The scientifics (then) almost vanish from the external memory.
That the external of the Word, of the Church, and of worship, vanishes from their apprehension. Signified, Explained. AC 10551.
If anything is separated from (that which is prior to itself) it completely perishes and vanishes.
As soon as any Spirit speaks to them, they vanish.
(This is mere) thought, which vanishes and is dissipated.
In proportion as the Internal is closed, truths and goods vanish. References.
As soon as anyone is brought... into his reigning love, he vanishes from the eyes of others, and is with his own...
Like rainbows... which vanish...
He knew that (the bird) would vanish, or cease, together with the affection...
As they then cannot but falsify the Word, their huts vanish...
The Angel (then) vanished.
(Consequently) both vanished, the virgins from the sight of the man, and the man from the sight of the virgins.
After some weeks, the things in (Melancthon's) room began to grow dim, and at last to vanish...
The Spirits suddenly vanish, because they do not perceive it.
That in the Heavens the external senses vanish. (Explained.)

The heads of the rest (of the Spirits) vanished, so that at last only as it were a shade appeared in the Spirits' place; and I afterwards heard that they had not believed what I said, and that therefore they appeared as vanishing or as absent...

In the Heavens... if anything of evil, of what is lascivious or insincere, has crept in, and they have not rejected it... the garden products and such like things appear either to have vanished, or to be changed...
A Spirit is his own affection, as is evident from the fact that... if another speaks altogether contrary to his affection, he vanishes, without going out through the doors.
If a man does not act as of himself, he vanishes.
As soon as the Spirit or Angel ceases from his thought and meditation, these animals and birds instantly vanish.
As soon as anyone attacks the love (of a Spirit or an Angel) he vanishes with his whole body, even though he were sitting shut up in the room. Explained.
In the Spiritual World (beasts, birds, and fishes) are appearances of affections, and they therefore vanish as soon as the Angel or Spirit goes away, or hia affection ceases.
